summary: Watched 4 Craze & Crash Shorts with retention plus the newest one; added one lesson about the second beat.
why: Every Short loses the most at its second beat (19-32% at 5.3-5.5 s). The worst were Tamagotchi (-32%, a head-office photo and a launch date) and Stanley (-19%, a black-and-white museum case and a walk-back line; stayed 29.2% against a 51.4% median).

findings.title: Second beat is where viewers leave
findings.detail: Tamagotchi -32% at 5.4 s, Toyota -23.5% at 5.5 s, Nokia -22.2% at 5.3 s, Stanley -19% at 5.5 s; no later drop passes 10.5%.

findings.title: Stanley holds worst
findings.detail: Stayed 29.2% against the 51.4% median; beat 2 swapped the viral cup for old black-and-white flasks while saying it barely sold.

findings.title: Juicero repeats the mistake
findings.detail: Beat 2 holds one stock photo of chopped vegetables for about 6 s; no retention yet, check Friday.

changes.title: Lesson added: the second beat stays on the thing from frame 1
